title: Alphabet's SpaceX Investment Valued at $94 Billion
summary: Alphabet's initial $900 million investment in SpaceX has reportedly grown to approximately $94 billion. This valuation makes Alphabet the largest reported institutional holder in SpaceX following the rocket company's IPO. The investment's value has increased over 100-fold in a decade, according to filings.
summary_points: Alphabet's investment in SpaceX is now valued at $94 billion.
This valuation makes Alphabet the largest reported institutional holder in SpaceX.
The increase in value is over 100-fold in a decade.
The information is based on filings.

summary_points_hi: SpaceX में Alphabet के निवेश का मूल्य अब 94 अरब डॉलर है।
यह मूल्यांकन Alphabet को SpaceX में सबसे बड़ा संस्थागत धारक बनाता है।
एक दशक में मूल्य में 100 गुना से अधिक की वृद्धि हुई है।
यह जानकारी फाइलिंग पर आधारित है।
